entries.title: Payroll service
entries.content:
The ARDB payroll service is for institutions and companies paying salaries to their staff. Payment is made automatically by debiting the company's base account, which may be a current account or a savings account, and crediting the staff member's account, again a current or savings account. This follows the payroll service agreement, the salary payment instruction letter, the effective payment date and any other attached documents.
The benefits ARDB lists are: reduced risk of handling cash, of fraud, of confusion and of errors in paying staff salaries; a more efficient salary payment process; less administrative workload connected with paying salaries; time saved and easier tracking of payment transactions; and additional benefits and special offers for using the payroll service. Other conditions also apply.

entries.title: Trade finance
entries.content:
In international trade, payment between seller and buyer carries high risk: the seller worries about not being paid, and the buyer about not receiving the goods as agreed. ARDB offers trade finance solutions to ease and reduce that risk.
DOCUMENTARY COLLECTION is a cross-border trade payment in which the exporter hands payment documents to its own bank (the remitting bank) and the documents are sent to the importer's bank (the collecting bank) for payment.
On the import side: handing over import documents costs 0.15% with a minimum of 40 US dollars; payment of import documents is a fixed 25 US dollars; and a disputed import document costs a fixed 30 US dollars plus a cable charge of 30 US dollars.
On the export side: checking and sending export documents costs a fixed 40 US dollars plus a document despatch fee of 50 US dollars; payment of export documents costs 0.15% with a minimum of 30 US dollars; a disputed export document costs a fixed 30 US dollars plus a cable charge of 30 US dollars; and an information enquiry costs a fixed 15 US dollars.
A LETTER OF CREDIT is a cross-border trade payment that secures payment between exporter and importer: the exporter is assured of payment and the importer is assured of receiving goods on the terms stated in the letter of credit. It suits exporters and importers of goods of every kind.
On the import side: issuing a letter of credit costs 0.15% per month plus a cable charge of 30 US dollars, with a minimum of 40 US dollars plus a cable charge of 30 US dollars; amending the amount or the expiry date costs the same; any other amendment is a fixed 25 US dollars; cancellation is a fixed 25 US dollars plus a cable charge of 20 US dollars; an intermediary bank's payment fee is a fixed 40 US dollars deducted from the amount payable; a discrepant document costs a fixed 40 US dollars deducted from the amount payable; and the payment service on a letter of credit costs 0.15% plus a cable charge of 20 US dollars, with a minimum of 20 US dollars plus a cable charge of 20 US dollars.
On the export side: advising a letter of credit is a fixed 20 US dollars; advising an amendment is a fixed 20 US dollars; confirmation costs 0.15% per month plus a cable charge of 50 US dollars, with a minimum of 40 US dollars plus a cable charge of 50 US dollars; and transferring a letter of credit costs 0.15% per month plus a cable charge of 30 US dollars, with a minimum of 40 US dollars plus a cable charge of 30 US dollars.
A LETTER OF GUARANTEE is issued by the bank to pay a stated sum to a beneficiary on the customer's behalf when the beneficiary makes a claim. ARDB issues bid guarantees, performance guarantees, payment guarantees, guarantee guarantees and shipping guarantees.
Issuing a shipping guarantee costs 40 US dollars. Issuing a guarantee costs 0.15% per month with a minimum of 40 US dollars. Amending the amount or the expiry date costs 0.15% per month with a minimum of 40 US dollars. Any other amendment is a fixed 30 US dollars. Cancellation is a fixed 40 US dollars. Payment, deducted from the beneficiary, costs 0.15% with a minimum of 40 US dollars.

entries.title: About ARDB: history, mandate, vision, mission and values
entries.content:
HISTORY. The Rural Development Bank was created by the Royal Government in 1998 by sub-decree No. 01 ANKr.BK of 21 January 1998, under the name "Rural Development Bank (RDB)", operating as a specialised bank focused on agriculture. In 2014 the Royal Government issued sub-decree No. 199 ANKr.BK of 11 June 2014 revising the bank's functions, duties and structure. The Rural Development Bank then changed from a specialised bank into a commercial bank and was renamed "Agricultural and Rural Development Bank (ARDB)" by sub-decree No. 124 ANKr.BK of 27 August 2019.
The Agricultural and Rural Development Bank, called ARDB Bank, aims to provide complete, efficient and sustainable banking services in support of agriculture and the rural economy, contributing to national economic development in line with the Royal Government's policy.
ARDB acts both as a commercial bank and as a policy bank for the Royal Government: it fills the financing gaps in development projects that private banks and financial institutions cannot fill. ARDB has been steadily widening its operations and its capital, and cooperates with many partners to provide efficient and sustainable financing and banking services to agriculture. It has brought financial services closer to customers by extending its network with a branch in Battambang province and 14 mobile offices in the provinces, serving farmers, agricultural communities, rice mills, small and medium enterprises in agriculture and agro-industry, and other parties in the agricultural value and production chain.
ROLE AND DUTIES. ARDB sets out its main roles and duties as: acting both as a commercial bank and as a policy bank; providing financing and related banking services, including credit, payment and deposit-taking services, to target customers in the agricultural production chain and the rural economy; providing policy support on financial and technical matters, including coordination and problem-solving in the production chain, agriculture and the rural economy, through finding markets, giving advice and building capacity; promoting the use of technology and innovation to strengthen the efficiency of its services and improve its customers' competitive advantage in the market; cooperating and entering joint arrangements with national and international financial institutions to provide financing or implement projects related to agriculture and the rural economy; implementing financing projects or managing other funds within frameworks of cooperation with development partners and the private sector; managing the Royal Government's intervention programmes and projects; mobilising capital and financing to expand ARDB's activities; providing other banking services connected with managing and allocating financial resources efficiently for target customers, while holding to the principles of good governance and social and environmental responsibility; and cooperating with the relevant ministries and institutions so that ARDB's roles and duties are carried out effectively.
VISION. The Agricultural and Rural Development Bank is a leading green and sustainable financing institution focused on developing agriculture, the rural sector and the green sector in the Asia-Pacific region.
MISSION. Developing strong and sustainable relationships with every actor in the agricultural production value chain, rural development and the green sector, through complete and inclusive financial services. Identifying, coordinating and closing market gaps in agriculture, rural development and the green sector, through strategic partnerships and financial solutions that use technology, green financing and sustainable financing. Diversifying the rural economy by providing green and sustainable financing services to small and medium enterprises in rural development. Promoting sustainable saving in rural development, and financial literacy.
GOALS. Transforming the bank into a fully digital bank providing green and sustainable financing through the use of artificial intelligence. Turning farmers into farmer-entrepreneurs through technical assistance and raising awareness, in order to promote exports and help safeguard Cambodia's food security. Promoting clusters of micro, small and medium enterprises for agro-industrial business, with the aim of building a sustainable agricultural production value chain. Promoting the green sector and resilience to climate change through green and sustainable financing.
CORE VALUES. Integrity, a core value linking honesty and professional conscience. Cooperation, a core value expressing communication and working together to reach a shared goal. Innovation, a core value expressing work carried out in a modern and creative way.

បំពេញតួនាទីជាធនាគារពាណិជ្ជផង និងជាធនាគារគោលនយោបាយផង
ផ្តល់ហិរញ្ញប្បទាន និងសេវាកម្មធនាគារពាក់ព័ន្ធ រួមមាន សេវាឥណទាន សេវាទូទាត់ និងសេវា ទទួលប្រាក់បញ្ញើ ដល់អតិថិជនគោលដៅ ក្នុងខ្សែច្រវាក់ផលិតកម្មកសិកម្ម​ និងសេដ្ឋកិច្ចជនបទ
ផ្តល់ការគាំទ្រជាគោលនយោបាយលើផ្នែកហិរញ្ញវត្ថុ និងបច្ចេកទេស រួមមាន ការសម្របសសម្រួល និងដោះស្រាយបញ្ហា ក្នុងខ្សែច្រវាក់ផលិតកម្ម វិស័យកសិកម្ម និងសេដ្ឋកិច្ចជនបទ តាមរយៈការស្វែងរកទីផ្សារ ការផ្តល់យោបល់ និងការកសាងសមត្ថភាពជាដើម
លើកកម្ពស់ការប្រើប្រាស់បច្ចេកវិទ្យា និងភាពច្នៃប្រឌិត ដើម្បីពង្រឹងប្រសិទ្ធភាពនៃការផ្តល់សេវាកម្ម និងបង្កើនឧត្តមភាពប្រកួតប្រជែងរបស់អតិថិជនក្នុងទីផ្សារ
សហការ និង/ឬធ្វើសហជីវការជាមួយគឹ្រះសា្ថនហិរញ្ញវត្ថុជាតិ និងអន្តរជាតិ​ ក្នុងការផ្តល់ហិរញ្ញប្បទាន ឬ អនុវត្តគម្រោងពាក់ព័ន្ធនឹងវិស័យកសិកម្ម និងសេដ្ឋកិច្ចជនបទ
អនុវត្តគម្រោងហិរញ្ញប្បទាន ឬគ្រប់គ្រងមូលនិធិផ្សេងទៀត ក្នុងក្របខណ្ឌនៃកិច្ចសហការជាមួយដៃគូអភិវឌ្ឍន៍ និងវិស័យឯកជន
គ្រប់គ្រងកម្មវិធី ឬ គម្រោងអន្តរាគមន៍របស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាល
កៀរគរទុន និងហិរញ្ញប្បទាន សម្រាប់ពង្រីកសកម្មភាពរបស់ ធ.អ.ជ.ក.
ផ្តល់សេវាធនាគារផ្សេងទៀត ពាក់ព័ន្ធនឹងការគ្រប់គ្រង និងចាត់ចែងធនធានហិរញ្ញវត្ថុប្រកបដោយប្រសិទ្ធភាពជូនអតិថិជនគោលដៅ ព្រមទាំងប្រកាន់ខា្ជប់នូវគោលការណ៍អភិបាលកិច្ចល្អ និងការទទួលខុសត្រូវសង្គមនិងបរិស្ថាន និង
សហការជាមួយក្រសួង-ស្ថាប័នពាក់ព័ន្ធនានា ក្នុងការបំពេញតួនាទី និងភារកិច្ចរបស់ ធ.អ.ជ.ក. ឱ្យមានប្រសិទ្ធភាព។
ចក្ខុវិស័យ
ធនាគារអភិវឌ្ឍន៍ជនបទ និងកសិកម្ម ជាគ្រឹះស្ថានផ្តល់ហិរញ្ញប្បទានបៃតង និងហិរញ្ញប្បទានប្រកបដោយចីរភាពឈានមុខគេ ដែលផ្តោតលើការអភិវឌ្ឍវិស័យកសិកម្ម វិស័យជនបទ និងវិស័យបៃតង នៅក្នុងតំបន់អាស៊ី និងប៉ាស៊ីហ្វិក
បេសកកម្ម
ការអភិវឌ្ឍទំនាក់ទំនងដ៏រឹងមាំ និងប្រកបដោយចីរភាពគ្រប់តួអង្គក្នុងខ្សែច្រវាក់តម្លៃផលិតកម្មកសិកម្ម វិស័យអភិវឌ្ឍន៍ជនបទ និងវិស័យបៃតង តាមរយៈការផ្តល់សេវាកម្មហិរញ្ញវត្ថុពេញលេញប្រកបដោយបរិយាបន្ន។
ការកំណត់អត្តសញ្ញាណ, ការសម្របសម្រួល, និងការដោះស្រាយ គម្លាតទីផ្សារ ក្នុងវិស័យកសិកម្ម វិស័យអភិវឌ្ឍន៍ជនបទ និងវិស័យបៃតង តាមរយៈភាពជាដៃគូយុទ្ធសាស្ត្រ ការផ្តល់ដំណោះស្រាយហិរញ្ញវត្ថុដោយប្រើប្រាស់បច្ចេកវិទ្យា និងហិរញ្ញប្បទានបៃតង និងហិរញ្ញប្បទានប្រកបដោយចីរភាព។
ការធ្វើពិពិធកម្មសេដ្ឋកិច្ចជនបទ តាមរយៈការផ្តល់សេវាកម្មហិរញ្ញប្បទានបៃតង និងហិរញ្ញប្បទានប្រកបដោយចីរភាព ដល់សហគ្រាសធុនតូច និងមធ្យម ក្នុងវិស័យអភិវឌ្ឍន៍ជនបទ។
ការលើកកម្ពស់ ការសន្សំប្រកបដោយចីរភាពក្នុងវិស័យអភិវឌ្ឍន៍ជនបទ និងអក្ខរកម្មហិរញ្ញវត្ថុ។
គោលដៅ
ធ្វើបរិវត្តកម្មធនាគារឱ្យទៅជាធនាគារឌីជីថលពេញលេញផ្តល់ហិរញ្ញប្បទានបៃតង និងហិរញ្ញប្បទានប្រកបដោយចីរភាព តាមរយៈការប្រើប្រាស់បញ្ញាសិប្បនិម្មិត
ប្រែក្លាយប្រជាកសិករ ឱ្យទៅជាកសិករសហគ្រិន តាមរយៈការផ្តល់ជំនួយបច្ចេកទេស និងលើកកម្ពស់ការយល់ដឹង ដើម្បីជំរុញការនាំចេញ និងចូលរួមរក្សាសុវត្ថិភាពស្បៀងអាហារកម្ពុជា
លើកកម្ពស់ចង្កោមសហគ្រាសធុនមីក្រូ តូច និងមធ្យម សម្រាប់ធរុកិច្ចកសិ-ឧស្សាហកម្ម សំដៅកសាងខ្សែច្រវាក់តម្លៃផលិតកម្មកសិកម្មប្រកបដោយចីរភាព
លើកកម្ពស់វិស័យបៃតង និងភាពធន់នឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ តាមរយៈការផ្តល់ហិរញ្ញប្បទានបៃតង និងហិរញ្ញប្បទានប្រកបដោយចីរភាព។
គុណតម្លៃស្នូល
សុចរិតភាព
សុចរិតភាព គឺជាគុណតម្លៃស្នូលមួយដែលផ្សារភ្ជាប់រវាងភាពស្មោះត្រង់និងមនសិការវិជ្ជាជីវៈ។
កិច្ចសហការ
កិច្ចសហការ គឺជាគុណតម្លៃស្នូលមួយដែលបង្ហាញអំពីសកម្មភាពនៃការទំនាក់ទំនង និងការបំពេញការងាររួមគ្នាដើម្បីសម្រេចបាននូវគោលដៅរួម។

entries.title: ARDB board of directors
entries.content:
ARDB is led by a board of directors, which it describes as serving as the bank's highest body with full autonomy in directing ARDB's operations.
The board is composed of: a representative of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, who chairs it; a representative of the Office of the Council of Ministers; the Director General of ARDB; a representative of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries; a representative of the Ministry of Rural Development; a representative of ARDB's staff; and a suitably qualified representative of the private sector. Each of these is one member, and all but the chair serve as members.
The members named are: His Excellency Ros Seilava, Chairman of the Board; His Excellency Khy Kosal, board member; Mr Pak Serivathana, board member (independent member); His Excellency Chheang Vannarith, board member; His Excellency San Visal, board member; His Excellency Dr Kao Thach, board member; and His Excellency Chan Seiha, board member and staff representative.

entries.title: Statement of the board of directors
entries.content:
A statement from the Chairman of the Board of Directors.
2021 was a year in which the whole world, Cambodia among it, was working to restore economic and social conditions to normal and trying to live along a new path. The COVID-19 crisis certainly had a negative effect on Cambodia's economic and social situation, but it did not halt the Royal Government of Cambodia's efforts to drive the development of agriculture. On the contrary, the crisis created opportunities for developing agriculture in Cambodia, both in the scale of investment in agricultural land and in cultivation techniques. ARDB, as an arm of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, is implementing the post-COVID economic recovery policy with the greatest care, through the release of special financing. As a result ARDB released this special financing fund, which covered the expansion of vegetable and fruit growing, aquaculture, animal raising and the processing of agricultural products; and the Royal Government continues to give its attention and support to priority sectors, agriculture among them. The Royal Government's special financing policy, carried out in 2020 and 2021, had strong support from farmers, agricultural communities and small and medium enterprises in agriculture.
In line with the strategic framework and the programme to recover and drive the growth of Cambodia's economy while living with COVID-19 along the new normal path for 2021-2023, ARDB continues to carry out the Royal Government's policy attentively and to follow its 3-year rolling business plan (2022-2024) in order to reach the bank's goals.
As Chairman of the Board of Directors of ARDB, I commend and thank the members of the board, the leadership and the staff at every level of ARDB, who have worked hard and actively at their duties in carrying out the Royal Government's policy and fulfilling the bank's mission, towards the shared goal: for farmers, and for social and economic development.

សារលិខិតរបស់ក្រុមប្រឹក្សាភិបាល
ប្រធានក្រុមប្រឹក្សាភិបាល
ឆ្នាំ២០២១ គឺជាឆ្នាំដែលពិភពលោកទាំងមូល ក៏ដូចជាប្រទេសកម្ពុជា កំពុងប្រឹងប្រែងក្នុងការស្ដារស្ថានភាពសេដ្ឋកិច្ច និងសង្គម ឱ្យវិលទៅរកស្ថានភាពប្រក្រតីឡើងវិញ និងព្យាយាមរស់នៅតាមបែបគន្លងថ្មី។ ពិតប្រាកដណាស់ វិបត្តិកូវីដ-១៩ បានជះឥទ្ធិពលអវិជ្ជមានដល់ស្ថានភាពសេដ្ឋកិច្ច និងសង្គមប្រទេសកម្ពុជា ប៉ុន្តែវិបត្តិនេះ មិនបានបង្អាក់នូវកិច្ចខិតខំប្រឹងប្រែងរបស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលកម្ពុជា ក្នុងការជំរុញការអភិវឌ្ឍវិស័យកសិកម្មនោះទេ។ ផ្ទុយទៅវិញ វិបត្តិនេះ បានបង្កើតឱ្យមានកាលានុវត្តភាពសម្រាប់ការអភិវឌ្ឍវិស័យកសិកម្មនៅកម្ពុជាទាំងទំហំនៃការវិនិយោគលើផ្ទៃដីកសិកម្ម និងបច្ចេកទេសក្នុងការដាំដុះ។ ធនាគារ ARDB ដែលជាសេនាធិការរបស់ក្រសួងសេដ្ឋកិច្ច និងហិរញ្ញវត្ថុ កំពុងអនុវត្តគោលនយោបាយស្ដារសេដ្ឋកិច្ចក្រោយវិបត្តិកូវីដយ៉ាងយកចិត្ដទុកដាក់បំផុត តាមរយៈការបញ្ចេញហិរញ្ញប្បទានពិសេស។ ជាលទ្ធផល ធនាគារ ARDB បានបញ្ចេញមូលនិធិហិរញ្ញប្បទានពិសេស​នេះ ដែលបានគ្របដណ្តប់លើការពង្រីកការដាំដុះ​បន្លែ-ផ្លែឈើ, វារីវប្បកម្ម, ការចិញ្ចឹមសត្វ, និងការកែច្នៃផលិតផលកសិកម្ម ហើយរាជរដ្ឋាភិបាល នៅតែបន្តការយកចិត្តទុកដាក់គាំទ្រដល់វិស័យអាទិភាព ដែលក្នុងនោះក៏មានវិស័យកសិកម្ម ផងដែរ។ ការអនុវត្តគោលនយោបាយហិរញ្ញប្បទានពិសេសរបស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាល ក្នុងឆ្នាំ២០២០ និង២០២១ មានការគាំទ្រយ៉ាងខ្លាំងពីប្រជាកសិករ សហគមន៍កសិកម្ម និងសហគ្រាសធុនតូច និងមធ្យមក្នុងវិស័យកសិកម្ម។
ស្របតាមក្របខណ្ឌយុទ្ធសាស្រ្ត និងកម្មវិធីស្តារ និងជំរុញកំណើន​សេដ្ឋកិច្ច​កម្ពុជាជាមួយកូវីដ-១៩​ តាមគន្លងប្រក្រតីភាពថ្មីសម្រាប់ឆ្នាំ ២០២១-២០២៣, ធនាគារ ARDB នៅតែបន្តអនុវត្តគោលនយោបាយរបស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលដោយយកចិត្តទុកដាក់ និងអនុវត្តតាមផែនការអាជីវកម្ម ៣ ឆ្នាំរំកិល (២០២២-២០២៤) ដើម្បីសម្រេចតាមគោលដៅរបស់ធនាគារ។
ក្នុងនាមជាប្រធានក្រុមប្រឹក្សាភិបាលនៃធនាគារ ARDB ខ្ញុំសូមកោតសរសើរ និងសូមអរគុណដល់សមាជិកក្រុមប្រឹក្សាភិបាល, ថ្នាក់ដឹកនាំ និងបុគ្គលិកគ្រប់ជាន់ថ្នាក់នៃធនាគារ ARDB ដែលបានខិតខំប្រឹងប្រែងបំពេញភារកិច្ចយ៉ាងសកម្មក្នុងការអនុវត្ដគោលនយោបាយរបស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាល និងបំពេញបេសកកម្មរបស់ធនាគារ ដើម្បីឆ្ពោះទៅកាន់គោលដៅរួម គឺដើម្បីកសិករ និងអភិវឌ្ឍន៍សេដ្ឋកិច្ចសង្គម។

entries.title: Statement of the Director General
entries.content:
A statement from the Director General.
Although in 2021 the COVID-19 crisis continued to affect the global economy and Cambodia's economy, ARDB continued to play its part well in carrying out the Royal Government's policy, in particular in delivering the Royal Government's special financing to restore and steady the businesses of farmers, agricultural communities and small and medium enterprises in agriculture. In 2021 ARDB achieved a number of significant results: (1) the total loan portfolio rose to 302 million US dollars, a growth of 21.75% against 2020; (2) the number of deposit accounts grew by 73%, a growth arising from the growth in savings deposit accounts and fixed deposit accounts, with the fixed deposit balance growing by 118.29%; (3) the launch of the trade finance service, which helps ease and drive the export of Cambodia's agricultural products; (4) the extension of the mobile office network to 10 provinces: Battambang, Banteay Meanchey, Oddar Meanchey, Pursat, Kampong Thom, Preah Vihear, Prey Veng, Tbong Khmum, Takeo and Stung Treng; and (5) closer cooperation with national institutions and development partners, with the aim of widening the reach of its financing and contributing to the sustainable development goals.
OUTLOOK FOR 2022. Based on ARDB's 10-year roadmap and the continued implementation of the Royal Government's policy of driving agriculture forward, with the aim of raising farmers' living standards and developing the economy and society, ARDB has set out its way forward clearly in its main business plans for the coming year 2022: (1) driving the efficiency with which the Royal Government's policy is carried out, and closer cooperation with national and international development partners; (2) driving the transformation of farmers into farmer-entrepreneurs; (3) driving the transformation into a digital bank, in both operations and customer service; (4) driving the diversification of funding sources and the practice of green credit; (5) driving deposit-taking and increasing and diversifying the loan portfolio; and (6) driving productivity and professional working practice through developing the capacity of human resources.
I take this occasion to express my respect and deep gratitude to the Royal Government of Cambodia, the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the National Bank of Cambodia, which have always supported ARDB and placed their trust in it. I also thank the board of directors and the leadership, who have always supported ARDB and given it good counsel; all the bank's staff, who have worked with all their strength of body and mind; and the customers and development partners who have cooperated with ARDB in advancing the development of agriculture in Cambodia.

សារលិខិតរបស់អគ្គនាយក
អគ្គនាយក
បើទោះបីជាក្នុងឆ្នាំ២០២១ វិបត្តិកូវីដ-១៩ នៅតែបន្តជះឥទ្ធិពលអវិជ្ជមានដល់សេដ្ឋកិច្ចសកល ក៏ដូចជាសេដ្ឋកិច្ចប្រទេសកម្ពុជាក៏ដោយ, ធនាគារ ARDB នៅតែបន្តដើរតួនាទីបានយ៉ាងល្អក្នុងការអនុវត្តគោលនយោបាយរបស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាល ជាពិសេសការអនុវត្តនូវការផ្តល់ហិរញ្ញប្បទានពិសេសរបស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលក្នុងការស្ដារ និងរក្សាលំនឹងអាជីវកម្មរបស់ប្រជាកសិករ, សហគមន៍កសិកម្ម, និងសហគ្រាសធុនតូច និងមធ្យមក្នុងវិស័យកសិកម្ម។ ក្នុងឆ្នាំ២០២១ ធនាគារ ARDB សម្រេចបាននូវសមិទ្ធផលធំៗមួយចំនួន ដូចជា៖ (១) សំពៀតឥណទានសរុបបានកើនឡើងរហូតដល់ ៣០២ លានដុល្លារអាមេរិក ដែលមានកំណើន ២១,៧៥% ធៀបនឹងឆ្នាំ២០២០។ (២) ចំនួនគណនីប្រាក់បញ្ញើមានកាលកំណើនចំនួន ៧៣% ដែលកំណើននេះ កើតឡើងដោយសារតែកំណើនគណនីប្រាក់បញ្ញើសន្សំ និងគណនីប្រាក់បញ្ញើមានកាលកំណត់ និងសមតុល្យប្រាក់បញ្ញើមានកំណត់កំណើនចំនួន ១១៨,២៩%។ (៣) ការដាក់ឱ្យដំណើរការនូវសេវាកម្មហិរញ្ញប្បទានពាណិជ្ជកម្ម ដែលជាសេវាកម្មមួយជួយសម្រួល និងជំរុញដល់ការនាំចេញនូវផលិតផលកសិកម្មរបស់កម្ពុជា។ (៤) ការពង្រីកបណ្តាញការិយាល័យចល័ត នៅតាមបណ្តាខេត្តចំនួន ១០ រួមមាន៖ ខេត្តបាត់ដំបង, ខេត្តបន្ទាយមានជ័យ, ខេត្តឧត្តរមានជ័យ, ខេត្តពោធិ៍សាត់, ខេត្តកំពង់ធំ, ខេត្តព្រះវិហារ, ខេត្តព្រៃវែង, ខេត្តត្បូងឃ្មុំ, ខេត្តតាកែវ, និងខេត្តស្ទឹងត្រែង។ (៥) ការបង្កើនកិច្ចសហប្រតិបត្តិការជាមួយស្ថាប័នជាតិ និងដៃគូអភិវឌ្ឍន៍ ក្នុងគោលដៅពង្រីកវិសាលភាពក្នុងការផ្ដល់ហិរញ្ញប្បទាន និងចូលរួមចំណែកក្នុងការសម្រេចបាននូវគោលដៅការអភិវឌ្ឍប្រកបដោយចីរភាព។
ទស្សនវិស័យសម្រាប់ឆ្នាំ២០២២ របស់ធនាគារARDB
ដោយផ្អែកតាមផែនទីចង្អុលផ្លូវរយៈពេល ១០ ឆ្នាំ របស់ធនាគារ ARDB និងការបន្ដអនុវត្ដគោលនយោបាយរបស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលក្នុងការជំរុញវិស័យកសិកម្ម ក្នុងគោលដៅលើកកម្ពស់ជីវភាពរស់នៅរបស់ប្រជាកិសករ និងអភិវឌ្ឍន៍សេដ្ឋកិច្ចសង្គម, ក្នុងឆ្នាំ២០២២ ខាងមុខនេះ ធនាគារ ARDB បានកំណត់ដំណើរឆ្ពោះទៅមុខរបស់ខ្លួនយ៉ាងច្បាស់លាស់ក្នុងផែនការអាជីវកម្មចម្បងៗ ដូចជា៖ (១) ជំរុញប្រសិទ្ធភាពក្នុងការអនុវត្តគោលនយោបាយរបស់រាជរដ្ឋាភិបាល និងបង្កើនកិច្ចសហប្រតិបត្តិការជាមួយដៃគូអភិវឌ្ឍន៏ជាតិ និងអន្តរជាតិ, (២) ជំរុញការធ្វើបរិវត្តកម្មប្រជាកសិករ ទៅជាកសិករសហគ្រិន, (៣) ជំរុញការធ្វើបរិវត្តកម្មទៅជាធនាគារឌីជីថល ទាំងផ្នែកប្រតិបត្តិការ និងការផ្តល់សេវាកម្មជូនអតិថិជន, (៤) ជំរុញការធ្វើពិពិធកម្មប្រភពទុន និងការអនុវត្តឥណទានបៃតង, (៥) ជំរុញការដាក់ប្រាក់បញ្ញើ និងបង្កើនសំពៀតឥណទាន ព្រមទាំងធ្វើពិពិធកម្មសំពៀតឥណទាន, និង (៦) ជំរុញផលិតភាពអនុវត្តការងារប្រកបដោយវិជ្ជាជីវៈតាមរយៈការអភិវឌ្ឍសមត្ថភាពធនធានមនុស្ស។
ឆ្លៀតក្នុងឱកាសនេះ ខ្ញុំបាទសូមសម្តែងនូវការគោរព និងអំណរគុណយ៉ាងជ្រាលជ្រៅចំពោះរាជរដ្ឋាភិបាលកម្ពុជា ក្រសួងសេដ្ឋកិច្ច និងហិរញ្ញវត្ថុ និងធនាគារជាតិនៃកម្ពុជា ដែលតែងតែគាំទ្រ និងផ្តល់ទំនុកចិត្តមកលើ ធនាគារ ARDB។ ខ្ញុំបាទ ក៏សូមថ្លែងអំណរគុណយ៉ាងជ្រាលជ្រៅចំពោះក្រុមប្រឹក្សាភិបាល ថ្នាក់ដឹកនាំ ដែលតែងតែគាំទ្រ និងផ្តល់អនុសាសន៍ល្អៗដល់ធនាគារ ARDB និងសូមអរគុណដល់បុគ្គលិកធនាគារទាំងអស់ដែលបានខិតខំបំពេញការងារអស់ពីកម្លាំងកាយចិត្ត ព្រមទាំងអរគុណដល់អតិថិជន និងដៃគូអភិវឌ្ឍន៍នានា ដែលបានចូលរួមសហការជាមួយធនាគារ ARDB លើការលើកស្ទួយការអភិវឌ្ឍវិស័យកសិកម្មនៅប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។

entries.title: ARDB executive management
entries.content: ARDB's executive management is: His Excellency Dr Kao Thach, Delegate of the Royal Government in charge of the role of Director General of the Agricultural and Rural Development Bank; His Excellency Pech Sany, Deputy Director General; His Excellency Chan Seiha, Deputy Director General; and His Excellency Ban Lim, Deputy Director General. One further Deputy Director General entry on the page is marked as still to be updated.

entries.title: ARDB cooperation partners
entries.content: In order to provide efficient and sustainable financing and banking services to the agricultural sector, and so contribute to developing agriculture and the rural economy within the framework of the Royal Government's national economic development policy agenda, ARDB cooperates with domestic and foreign banks and with financial institutions and international development organisations. The page introduces that list of partners but does not name them in its text.

entries.title: ARDB social responsibility activities
entries.content:
ARDB publishes a list of its social responsibility activities.
ARDB held a ceremony to sign a memorandum of understanding on the use of the services of the Agricultural and Rural Development Bank, for gathering and receiving charitable contributions for the Kantha Bopha Foundation Cambodia, between the Kantha Bopha Foundation Cambodia and the Agricultural and Rural Development Bank.
13 May 2022: a working group representing His Excellency Kao Thach, Delegate of the Royal Government in charge of the role of Director General of ARDB, brought a valued gift to a young boy named Kong Seiha.
4 November 2021: His Excellency Kao Thach, Director General of the Rural Development Bank, and the Khmer Hamilton-Phnom Penh Association visited orphaned children of the Future Light Organisation.
10 November 2020: a working group of the Rural Development Bank, representing His Excellency Kao Thach, Director General of the Rural Development Bank, brought 1 tonne of rice to support an organisation for the development of children and poor communities.
10 November 2020: the Director General of the Agricultural and Rural Development Bank attended the inauguration of a library and a fence at Hun Sen Prey Totoeng High School.
10 November 2020: a final football match was held between the youth team of the Union of Youth Federations of Cambodia at Peam Oknha Ung High School and the youth team of the Union of Youth Federations of Cambodia of Thmar Kor Commune, for the Union of Youth Federations of Cambodia trophy of Lvea Em District, under the presidency of His Excellency Kao Thach, Director General of the Rural Development Bank.
10 November 2020: Mr Bun Pheng, Governor of the Board of Governors of Khsach Kandal District, and colleagues attended a discussion event with grade 12 students preparing to sit the general upper secondary school diploma examination.
10 November 2020: His Excellency Kao Thach, Director General of the Rural Development Bank, as the high representative of His Excellency Academician Aun Pornmoniroth, attended a discussion event with grade 12 students.
10 November 2020: His Excellency Kao Thach, Director General of the Rural Development Bank and head of the Cambodian youth movement working group for Khsach Kandal District, as the high representative of His Excellency Academician Aun Pornmoniroth, visited Kandal province to help.
10 November 2020: a lottery event to select scholarship recipients and hand over the scholarships of His Excellency Academician Aun Pornmoniroth, Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of Economy and Finance and head of the central-level working group assisting Kandal province.
10 November 2020: the Rural Development Bank visited Mr Kong So, head of the dry-season rice association of Lvea Em District, to ask after his injury, after he lost a finger of his left hand in an accident while drying community members' rice.
10 November 2020: the Rural Development Bank contributed funds towards printing 1,000 copies of the book Hun Sen Cambodia and the book Outstanding Women, Former Farmers of Cambodia.
